id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_070.pack|cs_: "How dare you... Eleanor and {var:1}...! I won't forgive... I never will...!!
"Why does he know {var:1}'s name? Warrior... do you know {var:1}!?
"Irwin was king of this very kingdom of Dundrasil, and also a brave warrior of Dundrasil.
"...And {var:1}, Irwin is your father. To meet again like this...
"Irwin, why have you become like this? Let me see your face...
Ah... At last you have come. I have waited for someone to appear who would save him.
"I know this voice. It's the voice that asked us for help in the dream.
As you say, he is King Irwin, who ruled this kingdom of Dundrasil.
Sixteen years ago, in Dundrasil's tragedy, he fought on undaunted and defended the kingdom with the light of justice.
...But now that light has faded. He can neither live nor die, a sad corpse wandering a nightmare.
Please free him from the dark, sad nightmare. Shine light upon his despair...
"Now that we know this warrior is Irwin, we can't leave him be.
